name: Data Converter
description: Convert between JSON, YAML, XML, and Properties in one DBX workbench panel: instant conversion, mock data, validation and formatting, field-level JSON diff, a standalone JSON compare page, and line-level text compare. Pure frontend, no backend, works offline.
releaseNotes: 0.1.3: field-level structured JSON diff (only the changed values are highlighted), a standalone JSON compare page with a text mode, navigation overflow collapsed into a "More" menu, and a 300ms cross-fade when switching themes. Dark mode now follows the DBX host theme even when the host only reports theme metadata.
